site.metaTitle: SwapSpot - Taw ballooɓe ɓadiiɓe ɓe hoolaa
site.metaDescription: Rezerwu ballooɓe ɓadiiɓe ɓe hoolaa ngam laabal, defal, boote, kuugal ngesa, yaarugol jawaaji, kulle suudu, reenaare mawɓe, janngugol e goɗɗe.
site.hero.badge: Ina fuɗɗa jooni nder wuro maa
site.hero.body: Rezerwu laabal, defal, boote, kuugal ngesa, wallitugol yaarugol, reenaare kulle suudu e goɗɗe diga luumo gootol ɓadiiɗo.
site.hero.review: Mi rezerwi gollooɗo ɓadiiɗo e minti 10.
site.how.title: Ballal ina ɓadi: ñaɓɓal tati
site.how.body: Diga ko a yiɗi haa rezerwaasiyoŋ, alaa kooyngal telefon, alaa hakkilo, alaa devi laabaaɗi.
site.steps.0.1: Yiy ballooɓe ɓadiiɓe e kaartu jooni, taskaama no ɓadi e noote.
site.steps.1.1: Raaru profil, sarwiis e njoɓdi laaɓɗo adii a jaɓude.
site.steps.2.1: Neldu neldaare, heɓ devi e rezerwu nder app. Njoɓdi golle ndee ina jaɓee hakkunde maaɗa e balloowo ngoo hoore mum.
site.helpers.title: Wayli ganndal maa ceede ɓadiiɗe
site.helpers.body: Taskaago nde gootel, ɓaawo ɗuum sehilaaɓe ɓe ngiɗi ko a gollata ina rezerwa ma.
site.helpers.freeBody: Jogu 100% ko a keɓi. SwapSpot jaɓataa komisiyoŋ, alaa pursantaas, alaa njoɓdi ngam kliyaŋ.
site.perks.0.1: Winndu ganndal, foto e nokku golle maa nder minti seeɗa.
site.perks.1.1: A jeyi njoɓdi, raayon e wakkati maa.
site.perks.2.1: Heɓ ƴamle ɓadiiɗe, jaabo e devi maa.
site.perks.3.0: Sos miijooji e kliyaŋɓe ɓe ngaara kadi
site.perks.3.1: Heɓ noote ɗe wayla golle adannde kliyaŋɓe ɓe ngaarata kadi.
site.categories.title: Gollal kala, balloowo ngoodi
site.categories.body: Fannuuji sarwiis ɓadiiɗi ɗi adii nde ɗum fuɗɗi, e ɗum ɓeydeteeɗi ko luumo kala mawni.
site.trust.title: Sosaama ngam kisal ɓe ɗiɗo fuu
site.trust.body: Miijooji goonga, neldaaje suuɗaaɗe e kuuɗe ɗe accata sehilaaɓe ɓe jeyi anndinooje maɓɓe.
site.trustItems.0.1: Noote goonga diga sehilaaɓe goonga ɓaawo gollal kala.
site.trustItems.1.1: Jogu haala e devi nder nokku gootol.
site.trustItems.2.1: Anndin walla haɗ kuutiniroowo kala wakkati kala.
site.trustItems.3.1: Ittu kont maa e anndinooje maa wakkati kala nde a yiɗi.
site.trustItems.4.1: Ballooɓe ina jeyi no nokku maɓɓe hollirta.
site.waitlist.title: Heɓ SwapSpot hannde
site.waitlist.body: Raaru ballooɓe ɓadiiɓe alaa njoɓdi. Kuutinir paas nde a taskii neldude, ƴamde devi walla rezerwude.
site.waitlist.storeCaption: Ina ngoodi jooni e iOS e Android
site.waitlist.noSpam: Heɓ app, raaru ballooɓe, fuɗɗu nde a taskii.
site.download.title: Heɓ SwapSpot ngam iOS walla Android
site.download.body: Raaru ballooɓe ɓadiiɓe alaa njoɓdi. Kuutinir paas nde a taskii neldude, ƴamde devi walla rezerwude.
site.download.pointB: Raarugol alaa njoɓdi adii a jokkude e balloowo
site.footer.tagline: Luumo wuro ngam ballal ɓadiiɗo ko hoolaa. Waɗaama ngam renndooji nder Dowlaaji Dentuɗi Amerik.
site.footer.bottom: Taw ballal ɓadiiɗo ko hoolaa ɓadi e maa.
site.footer.companyLine: Ina golla les USPROJECT LLC · EIN 83-3989558 · New York, USA
directory.indexMetaDescription: Raaru paaje sarwiis SwapSpot ko fuu yiyata diga fannu e luumo ɓadiiɗo. Taw laabal, defal, yaarugol, janngugol, reenaare kulle suudu, boote, sarwiis profesyonel e goɗɗe.
directory.indexTitle: Sarwiis ballooɓe ɓadiiɓe diga fannu e luumo
directory.indexIntro: Paaje ɗee sosaama diga sarwiis ballooɓe ɗi tawtaama nder SwapSpot. Ɗe ballita kliyaŋɓe tawde raaral sarwiis goonga diga wuro, kod poosta, wuro maɓɓe, fannu, njoɓdi, ɗemngal e noote.
directory.statPages: paaje fannu e luumo ɗe ngoodi
directory.byCountryBody: Jokkorde kala les maɓɓa paaje ko fuu yiyata. Nde balloowo hollii nokku golle keso, ɗum yiyeteeɗum ɗoo ɓaawo nde cache sayt hesɗitinaama.
directory.emptyBody: Limto ina sosee diga sarwiis ballooɓe ɗi tawtaama. To jokkorde alaa ɗoo haa jooni, hootu ɓadaa walla maɓɓu app ngam raarude ballooɓe ɓadiiɓe.
directory.pairMetaDescription: Taw ballooɓe {categoryLower} nder {market}. Raarondir raaral sarwiis, nokku golle, njoɓdi, ɗemɗe e noote adii a maɓɓude SwapSpot.
directory.pairOgDescription: Raaru sarwiis {categoryLower} ɓadiiɗi e {market}, jokku nder app SwapSpot.
directory.pairSummaryEmpty: SwapSpot ina taskira raaral ballooɓe {categoryLower} nder {market}. Maɓɓu app ngam raarude ballooɓe ɓadiiɓe, raarondirde nokku golle e ƴamde devi.
directory.pairSummary: Raarondir raaral sarwiis {categoryLower} diga ballooɓe ɓadiiɓe e {market}. Kuutinir app nde a taskii neldude, ƴamde devi walla rezerwude.
directory.popularBody: Sarwiis ɗee ngari diga profil ballooɓe ɗi tawtaama, wanaa limto sarwiis tiiɗɗo.
directory.areaBody: Paaje ko fuu yiyata holla wuro maɓɓe, kod poosta, wuro mawɗo e raayon golle, ngam kliyaŋɓe tawa ballal ɓadiiɗo alaa holle adires suuɗaaɗe.
directory.namesBody: Sarwiis ballooɓe ina waylee ngam inɗe ɗaɓɓutaaɗe, ko ɓadiiɗo e paaje fannu, ngam kliyaŋɓe ɗaɓɓuta ko gollal goonga ɗo ɓe ngiɗi.
directory.inAppTitle: Haala e rezerwaasiyoŋ ina nder app
directory.inAppBody: Sayt oo ina wallita yimɓe tawde sarwiis. SwapSpot ina hisna devi, neldaaje, rezerwaasiyoŋ, miijooji e kuuɗe kisal nder app telefon.
directory.faqTitle: No paaje ko fuu yiyata gollirta
directory.pairFaq1Q: Mbaawi rezerwude ballooɓe {categoryLower} nder {market} e paaje ndee?
directory.pairFaq1A: Paaje sayt ndee ko raaral ko fuu yiyata ngam tawde. Heɓ SwapSpot ngam neldude ballooɓe, ƴamde devi, hollude adires timmunde e reenude rezerwaasiyoŋ.
directory.pairFaq2Q: Adires timmunde ballooɓe ina ko fuu yiyata?
directory.pairFaq2A: Alaa. SwapSpot holla nokku golle ko ɓadi no kod poosta, wuro, wuro mawɗo walla raayon. Adires timmunde ina suuɗaama e hollee nder haala tan nde ɓe ɗiɗo taskii.
directory.pairFaq3A: Alaa. Ballooɓe mbaawi sosde profil e winndude sarwiis alaa komisiyoŋ SwapSpot walla pursantaas. Kliyaŋɓe yoɓta ngam naatugol nde ɓe ngiɗi neldude, ƴamde devi walla rezerwude.
directory.pairListDescription: Raaral sarwiis {categoryLower} ko fuu yiyata ɗi ngoodi e SwapSpot nder {market}.
directory.cardsEmptyBody: SwapSpot ina maɓɓa profil ballooɓe ɓadiiɓe luumo e luumo. Heɓ app ngam yiyde sarwiis ɓadiiɗi, raarondirde njoɓdi e neldude ballooɓe nde a taskii.
directory.cardsBody: Raarondir sarwiis, njoɓdi, nokkuuji, ɗemɗe, noote e ganndal ballooɓe ɓadi e {market}. Adires timmunde e jokkugol hoore mum ina nder SwapSpot.
directory.cardNoDescription: Raaru raaral sarwiis ndii nder SwapSpot, ɓaawo ɗuum maɓɓu app ngam neldude, ƴamde devi walla rezerwude.
directory.helperDescription: {name} ina hokka {services} e SwapSpot ɓadi e {markets}. Raarondir raaral sarwiis, njoɓdi, ɗemɗe, noote e nokku golle adii a maɓɓude app.
directory.helperDescriptionNoMarket: {name} ina hokka {services} e SwapSpot. Raarondir raaral sarwiis, njoɓdi, ɗemɗe, noote e nokku golle adii a maɓɓude app.
directory.previewBody: Raarondir sarwiis ɗoo, ɓaawo ɗuum neldu e rezerwu nder app.
directory.noCommissionBody: Ballooɓe ina njogii njoɓdi golle. SwapSpot jaɓataa pursantaas walla komisiyoŋ diga gollal balloowo.
directory.servicesBody: Ɗum raaral sarwiis ɗi SwapSpot tawtii. Njoɓdi mbaawi wonde tiiɗɗo, sahaa fuu, diga walla ko ɗaɓɓitee, ngol e gollal.
directory.serviceFallback: Maɓɓu SwapSpot ngam yiyde sarwiis ndii, ƴamde anndinooje e tabbitinde ko ɗum hawti adii rezerwude.
directory.areasBody: Paaje ballooɓe ko fuu yiyata ina hokka e moteer ɗaɓɓutugol e kliyaŋɓe anndinooje ngoni: inɗe sarwiis, wuro, wuro mawɗo, nokku ko ɓadi e maandeeji ɗemɗe. Anndinooje jokkugol timmunde ina nder SwapSpot.
directory.continueTitle: Neldu, ƴam devi e rezerwu e kuuɗe suuɗaare.
directory.helperFaq1A: Maɓɓu SwapSpot ngam neldude balloowo, ƴamde devi, hollude anndinooje gollal timmuɗe e reenude rezerwaasiyoŋ no kisal nder app.
directory.helperFaq2A: Alaa. Paaje ko fuu yiyata holla nokku golle ko ɓadi no wuro, wuro mawɗo, kod poosta walla raayon. Adires timmunde ina suuɗaama haa kuutinirooɓe holla ɗe nder haala.
directory.helperFaq3A: Alaa. Ballooɓe mbaawi winndude sarwiis alaa SwapSpot jaɓa komisiyoŋ walla pursantaas diga njoɓdi golle maɓɓe.
directory.categoryMetaTitle: {category} ɓadi e maa - Ballooɓe ɓadiiɓe ɓe hoolaa
directory.categoryMetaDescription: Rezerwu ballooɓe {categoryLower} ɓadiiɓe ɓe hoolaa ɓadi e maa e SwapSpot. Raarondir profil, njoɓdi e miijooji.
directory.categoryBody: Raaru sarwiis {categoryLower} diga ballooɓe ɓadiiɓe nder nokku maa.
directory.cityMetaDescription: Taw ballooɓe ɓadiiɓe ɓe hoolaa nder {city} ngam laabal, defal, kuugal ngesa, kulle suudu e goɗɗe.
directory.cityBody: Rezerwu ballooɓe ɓadiiɓe ngam laabal, defal, kuugal ngesa, yaarugol jawaaji, kulle suudu, reenaare mawɓe, janngugol e goɗɗe. SwapSpot ina wallita sehilaaɓe raarondirde sarwiis, njoɓdi, miijooji e wakkati adii ɓe rezerwude.
directory.cityCategoryBody: Raarondir ballooɓe ɓadiiɓe ɓe hoolaa ɓadi e maa
directory.helpersMetaDescription: Wayli ganndal maa ceede ɓadiiɗe e SwapSpot. Sos profil balloowo alaa njoɓdi, suɓtu njoɓdi e wakkati maa, e kliyaŋɓe ɓadiiɓe ina rezerwa ma.
pricing.title: Raaru alaa njoɓdi. Kuutinir paas nde a taskii waɗude.
pricing.body: Kliyaŋɓe mbaawi raarude fannuuji e raarondirde ballooɓe alaa yoɓde. Paas ina ɗaɓɓitee ngam neldude, ƴamde devi walla rezerwude balloowo. Njoɓdi golle ndee ngee ina jaɓee hakkunde kliyaŋko e balloowo hoore mum.
pricing.freeBody: Raaru fannuuji, raaral ballooɓe, nokku golle e maandeeji hoolaare adannde adii a suɓtude paas.
pricing.plans.0.name: Paas ñalnde
pricing.plans.0.note: Moƴƴi ngam gollal gootal, ballal ko yaawni walla ndaarude SwapSpot.
pricing.plans.1.name: Client Pro
pricing.plans.1.note: Moƴƴi ngam soklaaji suudu, kawtal, kiray walla biznes saa kala.
pricing.plans.1.features.1: Neldu e ƴam devi wakkati kala
passPrice.seeStore: Raaru njoɓdi jooni e App Store walla Google Play
passPrice.referenceNote: Njoɓdi tiimtugol. App Store walla Google Play holla njoɓdi cakkitiingo.
passPrice.footnote: Njoɓdi cakkitiingo nokku e takse hollee e App Store walla Google Play adii soodugol.
staticPages.intro: Paaje ndee ina e ɗemngal ngal suɓtuɗa. Ngam ƴamle sariya walla ƴamle fii kont maa, jokku e hello@swapspot.org.
appPreview.title: Rezerwaasiyoŋ timmunde, diga fuɗɗoode haa timmoode
appPreview.messageA: Jam! A waawi laabude apartmaa suudu 2 Ase?
appPreview.messageB: Ee! Mi ina nelda devi jooni.
forClients.title: Timmin gollal alaa dogugol yimɓe
forClients.body: Maɓɓu app, yiy hombo ɓadi, raarondir profil goonga, neldu nder SwapSpot, e rezerwu nde ɗum moƴƴi.
forClients.cards.0.1: Ɗaɓɓutu e fannu, ɓadaare, noote e wakkati.
forClients.cards.1.1: Raaru profil, njoɓdi, miijooji, foto e sarwiis.
forClients.cards.2.1: Ƴam ƴamle, tabbitin anndinooje e taskir devi.
forClients.cards.3.1: Kuutinir miijooji, anndinol, haɗgol e kuuɗe kont nde ɗum ɗaɓɓitii.
cookieConsent.title: Suɓtuɗi suuɗaare maa
cookieConsent.body: Min kuutinirta cookies Google Analytics ngam faamde yaadu e wayleede SwapSpot moƴƴo. A waawi jaɓude walla salaade cookies analitik ɗe ɗaɓɓitaaka.
maintenance.text: SwapSpot ina yaaru e serweer kese. Ngam foti sahaa gootel, naatugol, hesɗitingol paaswoor e waylooji kont mbaawataa gollude. Ndaartu kadi ɓaawo seeɗa.
reset.title: Hesɗitin paaswoor maa
reset.intro: Suɓtu paaswoor keso, ɓaawo ɗuum naatu nder app SwapSpot e imeel maa e paaswoor keso.
reset.done: Paaswoor maa waylaama. Maɓɓu app SwapSpot e naatu.
reset.invalid: Jokkorde hesɗitingol ndee feewaa walla timmii. ƴam keso diga app.
reset.openLink: Maɓɓu jokkorde hesɗitingol diga imeel maa ngam jokkude.
reset.unavailable: Hesɗitingol paaswoor walaa e sayt ndan haa jooni.
